tweets.content: Coinbase freezing $3M in fraud-linked funds while launching SpaceX perps is a credibility crisis. Impact: Shows a platform prioritizing hype over fundamental security. Suggestion: Build your regulatory moat before building speculative derivatives.

When your L2 launches with a legacy exchange's prestige, but that same exchange keeps freezing millions from fraud rings while launching hype perps... The "trustless" narrative starts feeling pretty trust-dependent.

Impact: It poisons the well. Builders and users question if BASE's neutrality is just Coinbase's reputation laundering.

Suggestion: More aggressive, public chain transparency reports. Prove the decentralization isn't just branding.

[observation] -> Declaring DeFi "74% safer" while major exploits still happen weekly feels like a victory lap mid-marathon. -> [impact] -> Breeds dangerous complacency; teams and users relax vigilance. -> [suggestion] -> Shift the metric from "losses down" to "attacks prevented." Build fortresses, not just count the holes.
